title: Brulion Extension API
summary: A small JSON-like capability API for explicitly enabled local JavaScript extensions.

sandbox: no Brulion DOM or CodeMirror access
unsupported: direct DOM, storage, or File System Access access

fields.name: apiVersion
fields.description: Brulion extension API version used by the entry source.

fields.name: entry
fields.description: JavaScript ESM entry file inside the extension directory.

fields.name: permissions
fields.description: Capabilities explicitly granted to the extension.

permissions.description: Publish and remove commands in Brulion's palette and action bar.
permissions.risk: Adds user-invoked actions; it does not grant automatic execution.

permissions.description: Read the active editor and focus it.
permissions.risk: Can read the note currently open in the editor.
Can change the current editor buffer and trigger its normal save behavior.

permissions.description: List and read markdown notes in the granted vault.
permissions.risk: Can read user-owned markdown files in the vault.

permissions.description: Create, modify, remove, and move markdown notes.
permissions.risk: Can change user-owned files; guarded writes prevent silent overwrite.

permissions.description: Read the active note and resolve raw markdown or wikilink destinations.
permissions.risk: Can read which note is open and the note paths used for link resolution; it cannot change the view or files.

permissions.description: Open an existing note through Brulion's active notes view.
permissions.risk: Can change the active view and flush its pending edit through the normal guarded save path; it cannot create a missing note.

permissions.description: Move the active primary selection without changing markdown bytes.
permissions.risk: Can move editor focus and selection; it cannot write content.
Can display bounded messages without stealing focus.
Can request user interaction; dialogs are bounded and lifecycle-controlled.

types.name: ExtensionIconName
types.description: An unconstrained icon name string accepted by command registration; names that are not in the bundled Lucide catalog use the puzzle fallback.
types.declaration: export type ExtensionIconName = string

types.name: BrulionCommand
types.description: Metadata shown for a command in the palette and action bar.

types.name: CommandHandler
types.description: A user-invoked command callback. Its return value is ignored.
types.declaration: export type CommandHandler = () => void | Promise<void>

types.name: RegisterResult
types.description: The host identity assigned to a registered command.

types.name: EditorSelection
types.description: The primary active editor selection, using zero-based document offsets.

types.name: EditorSelectionRequest
types.description: Direction-aware primary selection control request.

types.name: NoteContent
types.description: Note bytes and the mtime used for a subsequent guarded write.

types.name: CreateResult
types.description: Creating a note never replaces an existing file.

types.name: SaveResult
types.description: A guarded note write either saves or reports an external-edit conflict.

types.name: MoveResult
types.description: A note move never replaces an occupied destination.

types.name: ActiveNote
types.description: Canonical active note identity.

types.name: OpenNoteOptions
types.description: Optional heading anchor for an active-view open.

types.name: AnchorStatus
types.declaration: export type AnchorStatus = "not-requested" | "found" | "not-found"
types.description: Outcome of an optional heading scroll attempt.

types.name: OpenNoteResult
types.description: Discriminated result for opening an existing note.

types.name: LinkKind
types.declaration: export type LinkKind = "markdown" | "wikilink"
types.description: Explicit link syntax accepted by resolveLink.

types.name: ResolveLinkOptions
types.description: Source-note and syntax options for link resolution.

types.name: LinkResolution
types.description: Discriminated, read-only link resolution result.

types.name: MessagePart
types.description: Safe formatted message fragment.

types.name: MessageContent
types.description: Plain text or safe formatted fragments.
types.declaration: export type MessageContent = string | readonly MessagePart[]

types.name: NotificationOptions
types.description: Optional notification severity.
types.declaration: export interface NotificationOptions { level?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error" }

types.name: AlertOptions
types.description: Required plain-text acknowledgement label.
types.declaration: export interface AlertOptions { okLabel: string }

types.name: ConfirmOptions
types.description: Required plain-text decision labels.
types.declaration: export interface ConfirmOptions { confirmLabel: string; cancelLabel: string }

types.name: PromptOptions
types.description: Required labels and bounded prompt controls.
types.declaration:
export interface PromptOptions {
  okLabel: string
  cancelLabel: string
  initial?: string
  placeholder?: string
  multiline?: boolean
}

namespaces.name: commands
namespaces.summary: Register user-invoked commands in Brulion's existing command surfaces.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Adds one namespaced command to the command palette and optional action bar.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Label, stable local id, optional description, and optional icon name string.
constraints: id starts with a lowercase letter
id uses lowercase letters, numbers, -, _, or .
label is non-empty and at most 120 characters
description is optional and at most 240 characters
any non-blank icon string is accepted; unavailable names fall back to puzzle

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Async or synchronous callback invoked after the user chooses the command.

errors: Rejects if the permission is missing, metadata is invalid, the id is duplicated, or the command limit is reached.
behavior: The returned action id is namespaced as <extension-id>:<command-id>.
The callback runs only after explicit user invocation.
The callback return value is ignored.
Any non-blank icon string crosses the API as metadata; names in the bundled Lucide catalog are rendered and missing or unavailable names use puzzle.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a command previously registered by this extension.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The local command id passed to register().

errors: Rejects if the permission is missing or the id is invalid.
behavior: Unregistering an unknown id is a no-op.
An extension can remove only its own commands.
methods.example: await api.commands.unregister("insert-date")

namespaces.name: editor
namespaces.summary: Read and change the primary selection in the currently open note.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the complete markdown text in the active editor.
errors: Rejects if editor:read is missing or the editor/vault is no longer active.
behavior: Returns the file-format text, including markdown markers hidden by Brulion's visual editor.
methods.example: const markdown = await api.editor.getText()

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Returns the primary editor selection and its text.
errors: Rejects if editor:read is missing or the editor/vault is no longer active.
behavior: anchor and head are zero-based UTF-16 document offsets.
When there is no selected range, anchor equals head; direction is preserved.
methods.example:
const selection = await api.editor.getSelection()
console.log(selection.text)

methods.name: setSelection
methods.description: Moves the primary selection without changing markdown bytes.

parameters.name: selection
parameters.description: Direction-aware zero-based UTF-16 anchor and head offsets.

errors: Rejects if editor:selection is missing or offsets are invalid/out of document.
behavior: Preserves direction and collapsed cursors.
Focuses and scrolls the editor into view.
Never replaces content.
methods.example: await api.editor.setSelection({ anchor: 10, head: 4 })

methods.name: replaceSelection
methods.description: Replaces the primary editor selection and returns focus to the editor.
errors: Rejects if editor:write is missing, text is too large, or the editor/vault is no longer active.
behavior: Uses the editor's normal document change and save path.
Does not expose the CodeMirror instance or DOM.
methods.example: await api.editor.replaceSelection("- captured item")

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Places keyboard focus in the active editor.
errors: Rejects if editor:read is missing or the editor/vault is no longer active.
behavior: This is a narrow focus action; it does not return a DOM element.
methods.example: await api.editor.focus()

namespaces.name: notes
namespaces.summary: Read and change folder-relative markdown files without exposing filesystem handles.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists every markdown note path in the granted vault. Paths that fail note-name validation are omitted from the listing.
errors: Rejects if notes:read is missing or the vault cannot be read.
behavior: Paths are folder-relative POSIX paths and include the .md suffix.
The reserved .brulion directory is excluded.
Results are sorted case-insensitively.
methods.example:
const paths = await api.notes.list()
for (const path of paths) console.log(path)

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads one markdown note and returns its content with the current mtime.
errors: Rejects if notes:read is missing, the path is unsafe, or the vault cannot be read.
behavior: A missing note returns { content: "", lastModified: null } instead of throwing.
The normalized path always targets a .md file.
methods.example:
const note = await api.notes.read("Journal/today")
console.log(note.content, note.lastModified)

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an empty markdown note without replacing existing content.

parameters.name: path
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

errors: Rejects if notes:write is missing, the path is unsafe, or the vault cannot be written.
behavior: Creates missing parent folders.
Returns { status: "exists" } and leaves bytes untouched when the destination exists.
methods.example:
const result = await api.notes.create("Journal/today")
if (result.status === "exists") console.log("Already created")

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes complete markdown content with an optimistic external-edit guard.

parameters.name: path
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

parameters.name: expectedLastModified
parameters.description: The mtime returned by the last read or successful write; use null for a create-only write.

errors: Rejects if notes:write is missing, a parameter is invalid, or the vault cannot be written.
behavior: Returns { status: "conflict" } and writes nothing when the on-disk mtime differs.
A null expectedLastModified refuses to replace an existing file.
Creates missing parent folders and preserves the markdown file as the source of truth.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one markdown note if it exists.

parameters.name: path
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

errors: Rejects if notes:write is missing, the path is unsafe, or the vault cannot be written.
behavior: Deleting an already absent note is an idempotent no-op.
The containing folder is not removed automatically.
methods.example: await api.notes.delete("old-note")

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves one markdown note without overwriting the destination.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Existing folder-relative note name or path.
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: New folder-relative note name or path.
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

errors: Rejects if notes:write is missing, either path is unsafe, or the vault cannot be written.
behavior: Returns { status: "exists" } when the destination is occupied and leaves the source untouched.
Returns { status: "missing" } when the source is absent.
Moves the file bytes without rewriting links or content.
methods.example:
const result = await api.notes.move("inbox/item", "archive/item")
if (result.status === "moved") console.log("Archived")

namespaces.name: navigation
namespaces.summary: Inspect and navigate the active notes view without exposing DOM, URL, or filesystem handles.

methods.name: getActiveNote
methods.description: Returns the canonical path of the note currently open in Brulion, or null when no note is active.
errors: Rejects if navigation:read is missing, the vault is no longer active, or the active-view callback fails.
behavior: Returns a folder-relative POSIX path including .md.
Does not read or write note bytes and does not expose the editor or DOM.
methods.example:
const active = await api.navigation.getActiveNote()
if (active) console.log(active.path)

methods.name: openNote
methods.description: Revalidates and opens an existing note through the normal active-note view.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional heading anchor without a leading #.

errors: Rejects if navigation:write is missing, arguments are unsafe, the vault is unavailable, or the capability call fails.
behavior: Returns opened or already-open for an existing target, missing for an absent target, and conflict when a guarded flush cannot safely switch.
A missing target is never created implicitly.
A successful anchor attempt reports not-requested, found, or not-found.
Uses the normal route, sidebar, recency, and guarded-save behavior.
methods.example:
const result = await api.navigation.openNote("Journal/today", { anchor: "done" })
if (result.status === "missing") console.log("Create it explicitly first")

methods.name: resolveLink
methods.description: Resolves one raw markdown or wikilink destination without changing the active view.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Destination only, without brackets or a display alias.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Explicit markdown or wikilink kind and optional source note.

errors: Rejects if navigation:read is missing, options or source paths are unsafe, or the vault/listing callback fails.
behavior: Reuses Brulion relative-path, basename/path, anchor, external-link, and invalid-target rules.
Returns resolved or missing with a canonical path and anchor, or external/invalid with the original target.
Does not verify heading existence, open a browser, navigate, create a note, or write bytes.
methods.example: const result = await api.navigation.resolveLink("../tasks/today.md#done", { kind: "markdown", from: "Journal/week.md" })

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows a safe host-owned notification.
errors: Rejects if the permission or bounded wire contract is invalid.
behavior: Never steals focus or accepts action callbacks.
Messages are bounded and rendered by the host.
methods.example: await api.notifications.show("Saved", { level: "success" })

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Shows an acknowledgement dialog.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Plain okLabel, maximum 80 UTF-16 code units.

errors: Rejects if the permission or bounded wire contract is invalid.
behavior: Uses the 120000 ms interactive deadline.
methods.example: await api.dialogs.alert("Ready", { okLabel: "OK" })

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Shows a decision dialog.
errors: Rejects if the permission or bounded wire contract is invalid.
behavior: Returns true for confirmation and false for cancellation.
Uses the 120000 ms interactive deadline.
methods.example: const yes = await api.dialogs.confirm("Delete?", { confirmLabel: "Delete", cancelLabel: "Cancel" })

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Shows a bounded text prompt.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Labels plus bounded initial/placeholder and explicit multiline.

errors: Rejects if the permission or bounded wire contract is invalid.
behavior: Returns null on cancellation and an empty string when accepted empty.
Uses the 120000 ms interactive deadline.
methods.example: const value = await api.dialogs.prompt("Name", { okLabel: "Save", cancelLabel: "Cancel" })
